annotation.justification: The clause provides a clear and unambiguous condition for responding to a RST_STREAM frame. It specifies that if an endpoint receives a RST_STREAM and has not sent a FIN or RST_STREAM, it must respond with a RST_STREAM containing the offset of the last byte sent. There is no ambiguity in the required behavior or in the definition of the final offset.
